🎲 Proving Grounds — the first rendered frame Phase 3

The spinning cube, one full revolution — re-rendered closer after the first capture framed it too small. The scene now lives where scenes belong: Projects/Project-ProvingGrounds (own descriptor, launcher, interchange code image); the engine keeps only shared code (Math.h + rendering machinery). Pixels come from a small CPU capture harness that mirrors SurfaceRaster.slang line-for-line — it stands in for the GPU until the SDK build; it invents no scene data.

📟 Log Stream — the first panel Phase 1

Rendered this session: the production C++ panel hosted in the TextureWorkspace composition — ControlCentrePanel over a host-owned PanelDockspace, exactly as FrontierMain now runs it — PanelDockspace with trapezoidal tabs (upstream's patched ImGui), the Frontier expansion notch, upstream theme. Since the first build of this page the panel itself was restyled to the approved prototype exactly — DM Sans faces, the prototype's pill chips, metrics with delta badges, sparkline, scrubber and new-entries pill at its pixel geometry; the menus are still the reused upstream DropdownControlSurface and the frame is the dockspace's (parity table in Exhibits/LogStream/PARITY.md). The only part this Linux sandbox substitutes is the OS window + GPU rasterizer (a CPU rasterizer stands in); every widget below is drawn by the same translation units your Windows build links. Generation: Exhibits/LogStream/PanelCapture.cpp · procedure in CompileProof.md.

🐞 TextureWorkspace — your screenshots, on record documented · not yet fixed

The other agent has the fix list (Docs/TextureWorkspaceComplaintReport.md). 🔍 Debug & inspection views handled

The demo's nine debug entrypoints (visibility IDs, glass layers, Hi-Z, LOD levels, cluster fallbacks, inspection march) are now engine units (Engine/Rendering/InspectionUnits) riding the same ordering/barrier machinery — proven in the 63/63 above, Editor/Development only. MatCap and CAD edges are viewport shading modes reusing upstream's existing preview shader sets, not new passes (Contract/DebugViews.md).

🧪 The panel compiles — and now renders — against the real SDK

LogStreamPanelPresentation.cpp and FrontierMain.cpp compile clean (-Wall -Wextra -Werror) against the genuine upstream headers @ c177821.
